final: WITH c AS (SELECT category, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining, SUM(amount - spent) AS total FROM budget WHERE amount >= 75 GROUP BY category), a AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM c) SELECT c.category, c.avg_remaining, c.total, c.total - a.avg_total AS above_avg FROM c, a WHERE a.avg_total IS NOT NULL AND c.total > a.avg_total
